harness.source:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,sys,time
from datetime import datetime,timezone
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'build/toolchain-upgrade';compiler=root/'build/toolchain/fairyc.exe'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
commands=[]
known_failures=[]
def run(args,timeout=600):
    args=list(map(str,args));start=time.monotonic();r=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',timeout=timeout,env={**os.environ,'PYTHONUTF8':'1'})
    commands.append(dict(command=args,exit=r.returncode,seconds=time.monotonic()-start,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr))
    assert r.returncode==0 and not r.stderr,(args,r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
    return r.stdout.strip()
assert not os.environ.get('CL') and not os.environ.get('_CL_')
config=json.loads((root/'toolchain.json').read_text());assert sha(compiler)==config['platforms']['windows/amd64']['sha256']
check=run([compiler,'check','--locked']);version=run([compiler,'--version'])
paths=set(root.glob('src/*.fy'))|set(root.glob('tests/**/*.fy'))|set(root.glob('tools/*.py'))|{root/p for p in ['toolchain.json','fairy.toml','fairy.lock']}
inputs=[dict(path=p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),sha256=sha(p)) for p in sorted(paths)]
profiles=[]
for profile in ['development','release']:
    folder=out/profile;folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
    for name,count in [('slice_frame_vm',4),('mixed_call_vm',5)]:
        cmd=[compiler,'test','--native','--capture-output','--json','--locked']+(['--release'] if profile=='release' else [])+['--file','tests/m2/'+name+'.fy']
        cached=folder/('native-'+name+'.json')
        if cached.exists():
            assert subprocess.run(['git','diff','--quiet','HEAD','--','src','tests','tools','toolchain.json','fairy.toml','fairy.lock'],cwd=root).returncode==0
            n=json.loads(cached.read_text())
            commands.append(dict(command=list(map(str,cmd)),reuse=dict(path=cached.relative_to(root).as_posix(),sha256=sha(cached),reason='Immediate preceding native invocation passed; only ignored harness recovery changed, tracked inputs and compiler are unchanged.')))
        else:
            n=json.loads(run(cmd))
        assert n['status']=='ok' and n['engine']=='native' and n['profile']==profile and n['count']==n['passed']==count and n['failed']==0
        assert len(n['tests'])==len({t['identity'] for t in n['tests']})==count
        assert all(t['identity'].startswith('tests::m2::'+name+'::') and t['outcome']=='passed' and t['trapCategory'] is None and not t['stdoutBase64'] and not t['stderrBase64'] for t in n['tests'])
        (folder/('native-'+name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(n,indent=2)+'\n');reports.append(n);print(f'PASS: {profile}: {name}: {count} native groups',flush=True)
    build=run([compiler,'build','--locked']+(['--release'] if profile=='release' else []))
    binary=folder/'browniec.exe';shutil.copyfile(root/'build/browniec.exe',binary);exe_hash=sha(binary)
    matrices=[]
    for name in ['m1','m2-array-call-reads','m2-struct-call-reads','m2-array-slice-parameter-source','m2-array-slice-alias','m2-array-slice-sub']:
        script='check-'+('m1-cli' if name=='m1' else name)+'.py'
        if name=='m1' and profile=='development':
            baseline=json.loads((out/'stack-comparison.json').read_text())
            assert len(baseline)==2 and all(row['exit']==3221225725 for row in baseline)
            if baseline[1]['exeSha256']!=exe_hash:
                source=root/'build/m1/development/arm-depth-mixed-10.brc'
                outcome=subprocess.run([str(binary),'run',str(source),'--json','--fuel','10000'],capture_output=True,timeout=30)
                assert outcome.returncode==3221225725
                baseline[1]=dict(label='upgraded-toolchain',exe=binary.relative_to(root).as_posix(),exeSha256=exe_hash,exit=outcome.returncode,stdout=outcome.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'),stderr=outcome.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
                (out/'stack-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(baseline,indent=2)+'\n')
                failure=json.loads((out/'known-stack-failure.json').read_text());failure['comparison']=baseline;(out/'known-stack-failure.json').write_text(json.dumps(failure,indent=2)+'\n')
            known_failures.append(dict(profile=profile,selection='m1',status='failed',case='arm-depth-mixed-10',exit=3221225725,comparison=baseline,scope='Original full matrix aborted at this case; not rerun or marked passed.'))
            print('KNOWN BASELINE FAILURE: development M1 arm-depth-mixed-10; both old and upgraded compiler images stack-overflow',flush=True)
            continue
        print(run([sys.executable,'-B',root/'tools'/script,'--exe',binary,'--profile',profile]),flush=True)
        path=root/'build'/name/profile/'cli-receipt.json';r=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
        assert r['status']=='passed' and r['exeSha256']==exe_hash
        assert r['count']==len(r['cases']);matrices.append(dict(selection=name,count=r['count'],receipt=path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),receiptSha256=sha(path)))
        shutil.copyfile(path,folder/(name+'-cli-receipt.json'))
    profiles.append(dict(profile=profile,native=reports,nativeCount=sum(n['passed'] for n in reports),build=build,artifact=binary.relative_to(root).as_posix(),exeSha256=exe_hash,cliCount=sum(m['count'] for m in matrices),matrices=matrices))
    assert all(sha(root/p['path'])==p['sha256'] for p in inputs),'Inputs changed during verification'
    (out/'partial-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(profiles=profiles,sourceSha256=inputs),indent=2)+'\n')
result=dict(schema='browniec.toolchain-upgrade-verification/v1',status='passed-with-known-baseline-failure',knownFailures=known_failures,recordedAt=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),baselineCommit=run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']),compilerVersion=version,compilerSha256=sha(compiler),lockedCheck=check,commands=commands,profiles=profiles,sourceSha256=inputs,harness=dict(path=Path(__file__).relative_to(root).as_posix(),sha256=sha(Path(__file__))),limitations=['Focused Windows native and tool-free CLI compatibility only; full native and M2 suites not rerun.','Linux compiler cross-built only, no Linux native compiler or Brownie execution.','DLL embedding, isolation, packaging, allocator instrumentation and timing benchmarks not run.'])
(out/'verification-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print('PASS: build/toolchain-upgrade/verification-receipt.json',flush=True)
